description:
After the dark complexity of recent output, 2015's Same As You is presented in sharp focus, as inclusive and accessible as the title suggests, while still maintaining the playful experimentation on which the band has made its name. 
The album’s focal point ‘Dont Let The Feeling Go’ sees leader Sebastian Rochford take on vocal duties alongside Hannah Darling and a choir of friends and collaborators. It is Polar Bear at their most direct: the song’s infectious life-affirming mantra stays with you long after the record has ended

More information: http://www.theleaflabel.com/en/releases/view/215/Polar%20Bear/Same%20As%20You/BAY%2098
